summary: Deployed inventory-worker as a sandboxed systemd service on node1 confined to /var/lib/inventory with NoNewPrivileges=yes; verified confinement and completed the mandatory node1 restart/recovery protocol with boot_id change confirmed.
actions_performed: Created inventory-worker system user and /var/lib/inventory data dir
Wrote long-running worker script and systemd unit with sandboxing
Enabled and started service, verified active and writing data
Verified via nsenter that writes outside /var/lib/inventory fail
Verified NoNewPrivs=1 for the running process
Captured pre-reboot baseline, rebooted node1, confirmed new boot_id
Verified post-reboot service auto-start, data preservation, and sandboxing intact

evidence.summary: systemctl enable --now succeeded, active and enabled
nsenter test: /etc write failed read-only, /var/lib/inventory write succeeded
Captured baseline boot_id and service state

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart executed and boot identity changed
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged then new boot_id observed after reconnect
Service auto-started, data preserved and resumed, sandboxing re-verified
